merges: There is a merge commit after that one. Rebasing across merges is not something Haunt does; pick a later commit.
changed: The list of commits changed since it was read. Open the rebase again.
squashFirst: The first commit kept cannot be squashed: there is nothing before it to squash into.
allDropped: Every commit would be dropped. Reset the branch instead.
noMessage: A reworded commit needs its new message.
